finish_summary:
1) bulk_discount_percent(50-99) returns 5 instead of 10, violating the spec.
2) parse_coupon is case-sensitive and rejects valid lower-case codes, contrary to specification that matching is case-insensitive.
3) Cart.items() returns a dict mapping item names to quantities only; the specification requires each value be a (unit_price, quantity) tuple. Consequently many Cart-related tests fail.
4) remove_item does not raise ValueError when trying to remove more units than exist, violating expected behaviour for over-removal.
